A stroke order and number-free on-line recognition method for Chinese characters is proposed by using the human knowledge of Chinese characters.

1) the ARGs of the Chinese characters can be built according to the segment relation structure and segment position structure of the characters, which are the human knowledge about the characters; 2) an optimal matching measure is defined between the ARGs; and 3) an efficient search method is developed to find the minimum cost path between two ARGs.
the proposed method is a stroke order and number-free method for on-line character recognition.
